a.xlink:title: Append a moderator/admin action to the server audit log.
Returns a QString from a std::string, truncated to at most MAX_NAME_LENGTH bytes.
Records a forgot-password request for the user.
Whether an unexpired forgot-password request exists for the user.
Read a value, preferring a per-run override set with setOverride().
True when the address is in security/trusted_sources and therefore exempt from per-address limits.
Record an attempt for key and report whether the key is now blocked.
Raw security/trusted_sources list; match addresses against it with isTrustedSource().
True if address is listed in the comma-separated trustedSources (security/trusted_sources).
Record an attempt as seen at epoch second now.
Drops keys whose last attempts have fully aged out of their window.
